_readme: Switching games mid-play, and the one script that proves the teardown really tore
It starts with --game=demo, so the picker stays out of the way and the world boots
straight in - which is also the proof that an explicit choice still skips the menu.
Then it reads the well, which sets a flag, and switches to the other game. If
GameState survived the switch, that flag would still be set and the quest's own gate
could be opened by something that happened in a different game entirely.

steps.text: read the well, which remembers being read
tab opens the picker over the running world
the cursor starts on the game we are in, so one step moves off it
and nothing the demo remembered came with us
